name: io.github.Orphograph/orphograph
title: Orphograph
description: Anchor a file's SHA-256 fingerprint to the Bitcoin blockchain via OpenTimestamps and verify the receipt later. Proves WHEN, not who: a receipt establishes that a hash existed at a point in time, never authorship, ownership, or originality. Hashing is local; file bodies never leave the device. Records are tamper-evident, not tamper-proof.

tools.name: orphograph_anchor_file
tools.description: Anchor a local file to the Bitcoin chain: computes SHA-256/SHA-512 in-process, transmits only the fingerprints, and returns a receipt id, receipt URL, and calendar attestation counts.

tools.name: orphograph_anchor_folder
tools.description: Anchor a whole folder (a dataset) as an RFC-6962 Merkle tree; only the manifest (relative paths, digests, root) is transmitted, and each file stays independently verifiable via an inclusion proof.

tools.name: orphograph_anchor_output
tools.description: Anchor a string of generated output (an agent's result, a model response, a transcript) without writing a file first; only the SHA-256/512 fingerprints are transmitted.

tools.name: orphograph_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify an existing Orphograph receipt against the calendars and Bitcoin chain; returns the anchored hashes, attestation counts, and Bitcoin block commitment time when available. No API key required.

tools.name: orphograph_verify_lineage
tools.description: Walk the parent links of a receipt's edit lineage and verify each link; reports anchor-time ordering only, not content similarity, authorship, or whether siblings exist.

tools.name: orphograph_list_vault
tools.description: List the signed-in subscriber's anchored receipts; requires ORPHO_API_KEY in the environment.
